Generative machine learning models is broader than LLMs; its tentative mapping to the taxonomy's generative-AI alias is flagged for review.
Model-performance optimization is not explicitly limited to inference; the inference-optimization mapping is flagged for review.
Docker and Kubernetes are treated literally as examples of the two jointly named practices, containerization and orchestration, rather than interchangeable alternatives.
Seniority uses the required 3+ years signal; preferred prior experience leading research initiatives is not a stated leadership duty in this role.
No German requirement is mentioned. Related field broadens the degree field, not an experience-based alternative.
